description: Returns the parameters a callable accepts, following `__wrapped__`, `functools.partial`, bound methods and `__call__`.
`POSITIONAL_ONLY`, `POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD`, `VAR_POSITIONAL`, `KEYWORD_ONLY` and `VAR_KEYWORD` decide how a value must be passed.
Maps arguments to parameters exactly as a call would, raising `TypeError` for the same mistakes, without calling the function.
Reads an attribute without running descriptors or `__getattr__`, so `classmethod` and `staticmethod` objects stay visible.
True for `async def` functions, partials and bound methods over them, and functions marked with `markcoroutinefunction`.
